result.instructions: Cooperators inter-agent broker. Tools forward to the local cooperatorsd JSON-RPC surface. Every tool except coop_register_agent requires an agent token (COOP_TOKEN/--token for stdio, Authorization: Bearer for HTTP).

tools.name: coop_instance_metadata
tools.description: Read the current instance's unique identity and display metadata.

tools.name: coop_retire_agent
tools.description: Permanently retire this instance and revoke its credential.

tools.name: coop_register_agent
tools.description: Register an agent name and return its agent id and token. Re-registering a name with its current token rotates the token.

kind.description: Agent kind, e.g. codex or claude

tools.name: coop_send_message
tools.description: Send a durable direct message to another agent's inbox.

body.description: Message body: a plain string or a {mime, text} object.

tools.name: coop_wait_message
tools.description: Long-poll the authenticated agent's inbox. Peek semantics: pass next_cursor to coop_ack to consume.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor; defaults to the acked cursor

tools.name: coop_ack
tools.description: Advance the authenticated agent's acknowledged inbox cursor.

tools.name: coop_heartbeat
tools.description: Record a presence heartbeat for the authenticated agent.

tools.name: coop_list_agents
tools.description: List registered agents and their presence state.

tools.name: coop_publish
tools.description: Publish a message to a named channel with idempotent dedupe.

body.description: Message body: a plain string or a {mime, text} object.

tools.name: coop_read_channel
tools.description: Read channel records after a cursor; wait_s long-polls for new records.

tools.name: coop_create_queue
tools.description: Create a named work queue.

tools.name: coop_enqueue
tools.description: Append a task payload to a queue.

tools.name: coop_claim_task
tools.description: Claim the oldest ready task under a fenced lease.

tools.name: coop_renew_lease
tools.description: Renew a task or document edit lease without changing its fence.

tools.name: coop_complete_task
tools.description: Complete a claimed task; the fence must match the live lease.

tools.name: coop_fail_task
tools.description: Fail a claimed attempt; the task requeues or dead-letters.

tools.name: coop_publish_doc
tools.description: Publish version 1 of a named document (inline or blob).

body.description: Message body: a plain string or a {mime, text} object.

tools.name: coop_update_doc
tools.description: Append a document version using compare-and-swap on base_version, optionally under an edit lease.

inputSchema.description: lease_id and fence must be supplied together when editing under a claim.

body.description: Message body: a plain string or a {mime, text} object.

tools.name: coop_claim_doc
tools.description: Claim exclusive editing rights on a document.

tools.name: coop_release_doc
tools.description: Release a document edit lease with its fence.

tools.name: coop_read_doc
tools.description: Read a document's head or a pinned historical version.

tools.name: coop_list_docs
tools.description: List document summaries, optionally filtered by name prefix.

tools.name: coop_get_status
tools.description: Return daemon version, pid, uptime, root, and per-log sequence heads.
